fields.rt-blog-html:
To launch your fast-food restaurant on the right foot, you need to define your concept, find a location, develop your business plan, and choose the right equipment. On this last point, our guide to the essential equipment for opening a fast-food restaurant details everything you need, from the kitchen to the cash register to the digital ordering system.

To get off to the best possible start, here are the four main steps to follow when opening a fast-food restaurant.

1. Define Your Concept for Opening a Fast-Food Restaurant

Before you get started, you need to come up with a concept for your restaurant. To do this, there are several key questions you need to ask yourself:

  • What kinds of dishes would you like to offer?
  • Who is your target audience?
  • How will your restaurant fit into its business ecosystem?

To help you define your concept, it’s worth observing how the industry’s leading players operate and drawing inspiration from their best practices. For example, you could analyze how the ordering kiosks at McDonald’s work. You can also look to independent fast-food restaurants that have managed to stand out.

To get started with greater confidence, you also have the option of opening a fast-food franchise. This way, you benefit from a proven business model, support, and brand recognition that you don’t have to build from scratch.

2. Develop a business plan

Now that your concept is defined, it’s time to put together your business plan. It will help you create a realistic budget, convince investors and banks, anticipate risks, and assess the viability of your project.

👉 Learn more: How to Create a Business Plan for Your Restaurant?

3. Finding a Commercial Space

Once you’ve defined your business concept and established your budget, you’ll need to find a commercial space. To do this, you should conduct market research to find a location that aligns with your business concept and target audience. The size of the space, its location, the rent, and its accessibility are all factors to consider.

4. Choose the right equipment and digital tools

Now that you've found your commercial space, it's time to set it up. Here are the main pieces of equipment to consider for your fast-food restaurant:

  • Kitchen appliances: ovens, deep fryers, grills…
  • Room furnishings: tables, chairs, counters…
  • Self-Ordering Kiosks
  • Restaurant POS Software
  • Online ordering and click-and-collect solutions
  • The Production Screen

Now that you have everything you need to open your fast-food restaurant, you can get started with confidence! Innovorder is here to support you on this journey. To learn more about the digital solutions we offer for fast-food restaurants, contact our experts.
